Most coverage frames it as a shot at Adobe and Figma. That read is too tidy.

What I watched happen in my own work: the real friction was never between designers and their tools. It was the 47 rounds of back-and-forth between a PM writing a spec and a designer interpreting it. That handoff ate weeks.

Claude Design, powered by Claude Opus 4.7, lets anyone generate UI prototypes and marketing materials from a text prompt. That sounds like a design tool. It is actually a translation layer.
